content.short: Otherside is Yuga Labs' multiplayer metaverse where Otherdeed land and characters from BAYC and other collections come to life.
content.description: Yuga Labs, which created Bored Ape Yacht Club, builds Otherside. It mixes MMORPG mechanics with a virtual world that players own. Otherdeed NFTs represent land, and Yuga collections such as BAYC, MAYC and Koda appear as characters. Thousands of players can explore and play together in real time, and the in-world economy runs on ApeChain. Mutants are among the Yuga characters players can bring in, and the world runs on ApeChain, an Arbitrum Orbit chain.
